headline: Second reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, plus a Community of Belonging Advisory Committee report and superintendent update.
summary: The agenda includes a second reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan. It also lists an informational report from the Community of Belonging Advisory Committee and a superintendent update.
items: Second reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan (action item)
Community of Belonging Advisory Committee report (informational)
Minutes of the October 15, 2026 regular meeting (action item)
Representatives' reports: Dropout Prevention, United Technology Center, Scholarship, and other
Questions and comments from the committee

Important dates: Strategic Planning Meeting on Thursday, November 5, 2026, 5-6:30 p.m. at Starboard Leadership Office; Reorganizational Meeting on Monday, November 9, 2026, 11 a.m.; Workshop Meeting on Thursday, November 12, 2026, 5 p.m.; Regular Meeting on Thursday, November 12, 2026, 7 p.m.; Regular Meeting on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, 7 p.m.
